verdict.rationale: Vue lists Pinia as an official first-party library, and community users praise Vue for shipping an official store (Vuex) rather than relying on third-party options like Redux, so global state does not require a third-party library. However, the evidence only describes Vue's built-in reactivity API in terms of component state and the rendering system; nothing documents using core primitives like reactive() for app-wide shared state, and Pinia is still a separate package. missing for 10: documentation of using built-in reactivity primitives for global/shared state without an extra package, Pinia feature-level docs, hands-on corroboration of a core-only global state pattern.
